You utter an insult so offensive that it cuts your target to the quick. Your target takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage and 1 persistent bleed damage and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half mental damage but no persistent bleed damage, and it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature takes full mental damage and full persistent bleed damage, and it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double mental damage and double persistent bleed damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 3}.

Heightened (+2) The mental damage increases by 4d6, and the bleed damage increases by 1.

You levitate the touched shield and send it to orbit around a creature. When you Cast the Spell and Sustain it, the shield uses the Raise a Shield action to protect the target creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Dancing Shield]

Heightened (4th) If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Shield Block] reaction, you can use your reaction to have the target shield use Shield Block when the target creature would take damage from a physical attack, in addition to the usual trigger. In this case, Shield Block protects the target creature, rather than you. Since the shield is using Shield Block and not you, additional effects or abilities that normally apply when you Shield Block don't apply.

target.value: 1 touched shield (unattended or in your possession) and 1 willing creature

description.value:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed].

You grant yourself supernatural sight in areas of darkness. You gain Darkvision.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Darkvision]

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Darkvision (24 hours)]

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range is touch and it targets 1 willing creature.

Heightened (5th) The spell's range is touch and it targets 1 willing creature. The duration is until the next time you make your daily preparations.

The target loses hearing; it must attempt a Fortitude save. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened] for 1 round.

Failure The target is Deafened for 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The target is Deafened permanently.

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dying] value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Death Knell]

You place a portal on the ground directly beneath a creature. That target immediately plummets into extradimensional space, falling a distance through an infinite, featureless void before being forcibly ejected from a portal that appears right above their original space and taking the appropriate fall damage. The target must attempt a Reflex saving throw. The DC to Arrest a Fall is equal to your spell DC.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target falls 10 feet through the void before reappearing.

Failure The target falls 20 feet through the void before reappearing.

Critical Failure The target falls 40 feet through the void before reappearing.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 5 creatures within range.

You spit out a green glob of dangerous acid that increases in size as it flies at the target, splashing around them as it hits them. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 2d12 acid damage, and acid splatters to the ground in the target's space and all spaces adjacent to the target. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage. The acid puddle lasts for 1 minute; a creature that enters or starts its turn in the acid puddle takes @Damage[(floor(@item.level / 2))d4[acid]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial acid damage increases by 2d12, and the acid puddle damage increases by 1d4.
